item.title: New DNA analysis adds evidence Jefferson fathered children with Sally Hemings

item.title: An emergency dig is on to recover displaced artifacts in Alaska before the next storm
item.description: During Typhoon Halong in 2025, thousands of objects from an archeological dig site in western Alaska were torn from the earth and scattered across miles of coastline. Now, there's an emergency dig.

item.title: A 16-year-old thought he was going to die in a burning a car. Then a trucker appeared
item.description: A 16-year-old fell asleep at the wheel while on a hunting trip with his dad. Pinned in the wreckage with a fire starting, he thought he was going to die -- until a trucker pulled over to help.
item.content:encoded: A 16-year-old fell asleep at the wheel while on a hunting trip with his dad. Pinned in the wreckage with a fire starting, he thought he was going to die -- until a trucker pulled over to help.

item.title: Rhiannon Giddens' banjo connects her to her ancestors: 'The spirits come through'
item.description: A self-described "folkie to the bone," Giddens sings and plays banjo and fiddle in this interview. Her latest album, Hope Is the Thing with Feathers, takes its name from an Emily Dickinson poem.

item.title: America 250: Unraveling the secret inscriptions inside Lincoln's watch
item.description: When President Lincoln's pocket watch was being cleaned in 1861, the watchmaker inscribed a secret message about a pivotal moment in the nation's history that still resonates today.
